It runs **3 or 5 independent "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"coding candidates** in detached Git worktrees, validates every candidate against project tests, rank"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"s the passing patches with `llm-verifier`, and keeps the original checkout unchanged until a separat"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"e approval applies the selected patch."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> [!WARNING]

Running several candidates manually creates"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" a new problem: comparing them consistently."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"This plugin turns that process into one approval-gated workflow:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"1. Give every candidate the same coding task.
2. Keep candidate edits in separate detached worktrees"},{"id":"p10s2","text":".
3. Run deterministic project validation before model-based ranking.
4. Exclude candidates that fai"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"l validation.
5. Rank the remaining patches with an LLM verifier when comparison is needed.
6. Produ"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"ce an auditable report and winner patch.
7. Apply the winner only after a second explicit approval, "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"then rerun validation."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **Best-of-3 or Best-of-5:** use 3 candidates by default, or 5 for higher-value tasks.
- **Validati"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"on-first selection:** failing candidates never enter model ranking.
- **Efficient ranking:** one pas"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"sing candidate wins by validation; two use one pivot; three to five use two pivots.
- **Two approval"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" gates:** one before candidate execution and another before applying the winner.
- **Integrity check"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"s before apply:** repository path, base `HEAD`, clean state, and winner-patch SHA-256 are checked ag"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"ain.
- **Auditable artifacts:** reports include rankings, changed files, timings, process status, pa"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"tch hashes, verifier requests, and token usage.
